function: Meta-TD3 jointly optimizes FIM element positions, BS transmit beamformer, and STAR-BD-RIS phase shifts to maximize the short-block-length sum rate under SINR and power constraints (p. 1, p. 4)
system: Downlink MISO: BS with FIM (P=16 elements, UPA), cell-wise single-connected STAR-BD-RIS (F=20x20), N=6 single-antenna users in transmission and reflection sectors; band not stated (p. 2, p. 5)
method: Meta-TD3: TD3 actor-critic reinforcement learning with a learnable meta-critic trained by bi-level meta-learning on replay-buffer training and validation batches (p. 4)
data_channel: Custom multipath field-response model, D=16 paths, i.i.d. complex Gaussian path gains with path loss; no standard channel model, dataset, or measurement (p. 2, p. 5)
test_conditions: No separate training and test conditions described; results swept over transmit power, SINR threshold, and number of STAR-BD-RIS elements (p. 5)
baselines: Learned SAC; architecture variants (FPA instead of FIM, STAR-RIS instead of STAR-BD-RIS) each solved with Meta-TD3 or SAC; no non-learned baseline (p. 4, p. 5)
metrics: Sum rate with finite block length (bps/Hz) versus transmit power, SINR threshold, and number of STAR-BD-RIS elements; reward convergence (p. 4, p. 5)
q1_support: p. 2: "independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) complex Gaussian random variables" - custom multipath model with i.i.d. Gaussian path gains; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 5: "the impact of the number of STAR-BD-RIS elements on the achievable sum rate is examined under different reinforcement learning settings" - a sweep of system size; no test of a trained model on unseen conditions, and the generalization claims are not backed by such a test.
q3_support: p. 4: "For performance evaluation, SAC is considered as the baseline." - SAC is a learned baseline, but Figs. 3-4 compare only learned schemes (Meta-TD3 or SAC on STAR-RIS/STAR-BD-RIS, FIM/FPA); no non-learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "Although Meta-TD3 requires more episodes to converge compared to SAC" - qualitative training remark only; no complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count, or runtime; Table I (p. 5) lists hidden-layer sizes as hyperparameters.
q5_support: p. 4: "All simulation parameters are summarized in Table I." - simulated data, no code or data link or DOI, and no public dataset or measurement.
notes: PDF is the arXiv preprint 2509.16417v1 (19 Sep 2025), titled Hybrid FIM and STAR-BD-RIS-Aided Wireless Communications with Short Packet Length: A Meta-TD3 Approach; it does not print the DOI, so the DOI-to-title match cannot be checked from the file. STAR-BD-RIS is modeled cell-wise single-connected with diagonal phase matrices (p. 3). The paper claims better generalization from meta-learning (p. 5) but describes no test on unseen conditions. Carrier frequency is not given. Figs. 3-4 compare only learned schemes, so q3=0 for lack of a non-learned baseline.
